{{Top|leg}}
A '''fireglobe''' was a device used to produce illumination. Crafted of [[Glass/Legends|glass]] and metal, each one was unique, and included a different form of light, be it [[Candle/Legends|candle]], [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], or a naturally incandescent animal, and was marked in some fashion to advertise the skill of its creator.
